items.stem: A Gram stain shows purple cocci in clusters. The purple colour indicates the organisms are:

options.text: Gram-positive, with a thick peptidoglycan cell wall
options.rationale: Correct: Gram-positive cells retain the crystal violet stain because of their thick peptidoglycan wall.

options.text: Gram-negative, with a thin peptidoglycan layer
options.rationale: Gram-negative cells lose the crystal violet and appear pink/red, not purple.

options.text: Viruses, which have no cell wall
options.rationale: Viruses are not visualised by Gram stain and have no peptidoglycan.
Fungal walls contain chitin and are not classified by the Gram reaction.

items.explanation: Correct: Gram-positive cells retain the crystal violet stain because of their thick peptidoglycan wall.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why are antibiotics ineffective against the common cold?

options.text: The cold is caused by viruses, which lack the bacterial targets antibiotics act on
options.rationale: Correct: antibiotics target bacterial structures and processes that viruses do not possess.

options.text: The dose of antibiotic is always too low
options.rationale: The problem is the target, not the dose; viruses lack the bacterial targets entirely.

options.text: Cold viruses are resistant forms of bacteria
options.rationale: Viruses are not bacteria and are not a resistant bacterial form.

options.text: Antibiotics only work after symptoms resolve
options.rationale: Timing is not the issue; antibiotics have no antiviral mechanism here.

items.explanation: Correct: antibiotics target bacterial structures and processes that viruses do not possess.

items.stem: Which TWO are links in the chain of infection that an intervention could break? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: interrupting transmission, for example by hand hygiene, breaks the chain.
Correct: protecting the portal of entry, for example by wound dressing, breaks the chain.
The Gram reaction is a classification feature, not a link in the chain of infection.
Half-life is a pharmacokinetic property, not a link in the chain of infection.
